purpose: Measure externally observable worker I/O without asking the model to invent timings, operation counts, or a fake zero. Keep local reasoning/work coalesced into stage/RETURN summaries and reuse the existing worker pipeline/event/receipt mechanisms.

measurement_law.externally_observed_wins: Externally observed counters must come from tool/transport/commit/workflow/artifact evidence. Model prose never upgrades UNKNOWN to a number.
measurement_law.zero_requires_closed_coverage: A numeric zero is valid only when coverage=COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE and coverage_evidence_refs proves the observed external trace or bounded fixture is closed for that counter.
measurement_law.unknown_is_honest: When the runtime cannot reconstruct a complete external trace, use UNKNOWN plus unknown_reason; never infer zero from missing evidence.
measurement_law.wall_clock: External wall-clock is optional diagnostic telemetry only. Model-authored timestamps or duration guesses are not performance evidence.

external_read_ops.counts: Successful or failed external read operations visible in the bounded runtime/tool trace, such as GitHub fetch/read, connector reads, public network reads, or workflow/log reads.
external_read_ops.does_not_count: Pure local reasoning, already-present prompt/context, in-memory parsing, local deterministic validation.
external_read_ops.evidence: operation/trace refs; zero additionally needs closed coverage evidence

external_write_ops.counts: External mutation attempts visible in the bounded trace, including durable GitHub file writes/updates/comments or other authorized external mutations.
external_write_ops.does_not_count: Local temporary files, in-memory transforms, prose generated before transport.
external_write_ops.evidence: write/commit/transport refs; failed attempts may count as operations when externally observed

commits.counts: Distinct durable commit SHAs caused by the measured unit.
commits.dedupe: Count a SHA once even if cited by multiple receipts.
commits.evidence: exact commit refs or a closed commit list

workflow_waits.counts: Explicit externally observed workflow-status wait/poll cycles attributable to the measured unit.
workflow_waits.does_not_count: Workflow execution time itself or unobserved waiting.

retries.counts: Repeated external operation attempts after an observed failure/conflict for the same intended action.
retries.evidence: paired failure + retry/success refs where available

artifact_count.counts: Externally observed durable artifacts emitted by the unit.
artifact_count.evidence: artifact ids/refs or closed artifact listing

artifact_bytes.counts: Sum of externally reported artifact byte sizes for the same bounded artifact set.
artifact_bytes.evidence: artifact metadata with sizes; never estimate from prose

record_shape.measurement_scope: bounded description of which external trace/events are covered

model_self_reported.claimed_local_operations: optional diagnostic; never authoritative for external counters
model_self_reported.claimed_timing: optional diagnostic; never authoritative wall clock

local_work_summary.summary: one coalesced summary for many local operations

coalescing.rule: Accumulate observable counters during the unit, then persist one compact measurement object. Existing ROUTED/STARTED/CLOSE and heartbeat mechanisms remain unchanged.

fail_when: numeric zero with coverage other than COMPLETE_FOR_SCOPE
model_self_reported value used as externally_observed evidence
